text:
By Andrew Kim ,
9 hours ago New York Knicks at San Antonio Spurs Game 1 NBA Finals Preview, Prediction & Odds | June 3, 2026 The New York Knicks face the San Antonio Spurs on June 5, 2026, in Game 1 of the NBA Finals, as the first matchup since the NBA Cup could determine who can set the tone for the Finals early.
Knicks vs. Spurs Game Information Matchup: New York Knicks vs San Antonio Spurs
Date: June 3, 2026
Time: 8:30 PM ET
Location: Frost Bank Center, San Antonio, TX
TV Channel: ABC
Streaming: ESPN+
Knicks vs Spurs Odds Betting Market Knicks Spurs Spread -3.5 +3.5 Moneyline -145 +125 Total O 207.5 U 207.5 The latest betting odds currently favor the Knicks , who enter Game 1 with strong momentum and a more experienced playoff core. Bettors should continue monitoring line movement and any late-breaking updates as tip-off approaches, since both teams rely heavily on their star players to dictate the flow of the game.
Key Matchup The most important matchup in this game is the duel between Jalen Brunson and Victor Wembanyama. Brunson’s ability to control pace, create efficient offense, and deliver in high-pressure moments has been central to New York’s postseason success. Wembanyama, on the other hand, has transformed San Antonio’s defense with his elite rim protection and disruptive length while also emerging as a versatile offensive weapon. The outcome of Game 1 may hinge on whether Brunson can consistently generate quality looks against Wembanyama’s interior presence.
Betting Trends Knicks ATS — New York has covered the spread in seven of its last ten playoff games, showing strong consistency. Spurs Home Performance — San Antonio has won five of its last six home games, benefiting from a loud and energized crowd. Over/Under Trends — The Under has hit in six of the Knicks’ last eight contests, reflecting their defensive intensity and slower pace. Injury Report Mitchell Robinson — Probable Knicks vs Spurs Prediction This matchup features a clash between New York’s disciplined half-court execution and San Antonio’s dynamic, Wembanyama -led defense. The Knicks have shown they can win tight, physical games, and their experience in late-game situations gives them a slight edge in the series opener. The Spurs will rely heavily on Wembanyama’s impact, but the Knicks’ depth and composure may prove decisive in Game 1.
New York’s ability to generate consistent offense, combined with its defensive versatility, positions it well to secure the first win of the series on the road.
Prediction: Knicks 104, Spurs 97
